title: SAMNJ24 build code: a social accounting matrix for New Jersey 2024
description:
Deterministic Python chain that builds the Social Accounting Matrix for New Jersey 2024 (SAMNJ24) from New Jersey's 2024 state input-output accounts and the national 421-sector supply-use tables. run_samnj24.py writes the state direct-requirements and Use matrices (Stage A), the 65-account core SAM (Stage B), the 19-account institutional SAM (Stage C), the control totals and accounting checks (Stage D), and the 75-account core SAM with federal, state and local government, five tax accounts and a subsidy account (Stage E). code/recon2024_package and code/scripts hold the upstream RECON2024 code that produces the state inputs; code/RUN_ORDER_upstream.md gives the order in which it was run.

The data this code reads are deposited separately; see the repository README.
